name: desktop-electron-specs-native
goal: Desktop test:e2e stays headless Chromium; every Electron-launching spec runs only through test:native

evidence: After merging main 8d779bc (PR 39) at c6c77ec, desktop test:e2e (chromium project) still takes game-native.spec.ts, whose fixture launches Electron via _electron. Main's contract: test:e2e launches no Electron app; Electron suites run only through test:native.

packages/desktop/test/test-preview-refusal.test.ts checks project routing only for two named specs (native-desktop, ui-hosted), so an Electron spec added on a branch is never classified. Strengthen it to classify every tests/e2e spec by its own or local-fixture _electron use and require chromium to ignore, and native to match, exactly those.
